_doc: Single source of truth for heartbeat monitoring (docs/monitoring.md). `crons` entries are BOTH the cron rules config/server.ts registers AND the Healthchecks checks scripts/provision-healthchecks.mjs provisions; `pings` entries are simple-period checks pinged from request paths, provisioned only. Check slugs are `${HEALTHCHECKS_SLUG_PREFIX}-${name}` — the ONE formula shared by heartbeat.ts and the provision script; change it in both or every ping 404s. Re-run the provision script with --apply after any change here.

cam-model-cleanup.desc: Daily registry retention (cam-model-tasks.ts cleanupExpired). /fail carries the failed-deletion count or abort reason.

cam-model-profiles.desc: Hourly BongaCams profile photo ingest (ingestProfilePhotos). /fail = every attempt in a run failed (dead CDN / blocked IP).

cam-model-snapshots.desc: Hourly live snapshot capture (captureSnapshots). /fail = every attempt in a run failed (dead thumb host / upload provider).

cam-model-activity-backfill.desc: One-shot lemoncams history import; done-state ticks still ping. Delete this check when the cron is retired (#65).

cam-roster-sync.desc: Roster sync heartbeat (POST /api/cam-models/sync; cadence = frontend SYNC_INTERVAL_MS ~5 min — retune both together; 10m period + 10m grace = deliberate margin). /fail = a provider feed failing CONTINUOUSLY for 10 min (single polls are covered by retention and do not page) or the lastSeenAt bulk touch broke; silence = the sync chain is broken.
